test.title: Section 1 · swimming pool and bike hire

topic.en: Two everyday notices: a swimming pool timetable and rules, and bicycle hire in a park.
topic.kk: Екі тұрмыстық хабарландыру: бассейн кестесі мен ережелері, саябақтағы велосипед жалдау.
topic.ru: Два бытовых объявления: расписание и правила бассейна, прокат велосипедов в парке.

paragraphs.text: Ashford Leisure Pool — summer timetable. From 1 June to 31 August the pool is open Monday to Friday from 6.30 am to 9 pm, and at weekends from 8 am to 7 pm. Lane swimming for adults runs every weekday morning until 9 am; the pool is then given over to school groups until midday, and general swimming begins at 12.15 pm.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Family sessions are held on Saturday and Sunday afternoons, when the wave machine is switched on for twenty minutes every hour. Children under eight must be accompanied in the water by an adult aged sixteen or over, and one adult may bring no more than two children under eight. Armbands are lent free of charge at the poolside; inflatable toys brought from home are not allowed in the main pool but may be used in the shallow learner pool at quiet times.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Tickets are sold at the door and online. A single adult swim costs £5.20, a child swim £3.10, and a family ticket covering two adults and up to three children £14. Season tickets are available by the month or by the year and are not transferable. Lockers take a returnable £1 coin. Please note that the changing rooms close fifteen minutes after the pool, and the last entry is thirty minutes before closing time.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Ride Green — bicycle hire in Marlow Country Park. Bikes are hired from the wooden hut by the main car park, open daily from 9 am to 6 pm in summer and from 10 am to 4 pm between November and February. No booking is needed for one or two bikes on weekdays; groups of six or more should book at least three days in advance by telephone, as the number of adult bikes is limited.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Hire is charged by the hour or by the day: £6 for the first hour, £4 for each hour after that, and £22 for a full day. Child bikes and trailers are half price. A helmet is included in the price and must be worn by riders under sixteen; helmets are checked for fit by staff before you leave the hut. A deposit is not taken, but one rider in each group must leave a form of identification at the desk until the bikes are returned.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Bikes may be ridden anywhere on the park’s surfaced paths and on the gravel track around the lake. They may not be taken onto the meadow, onto the wooden boardwalk through the reed beds, or outside the park gates. If a bike develops a fault, telephone the number printed on the frame; a member of staff will come out to you, and the time lost will not be charged. Riders who return a bike after closing time will be charged a full extra hour.
paragraphs.label: C
